memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for initial endocrinology consultation with Dr Karthik Hegde on 2025-04-05 at 09:30. Patient to bring recent weight and waist measurements.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity: BMI 34.2, waist 102 cm (>90 cm male cut-off, female 80 cm). Status: ongoing. Plan: continue orlistat 120 mg with each main meal, advise low-calorie diet, increase walking to 30 mins daily.
- NAFLD: ALT 48 U/L, AST 44 U/L. Status: mild hepatosteatosis. Plan: continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, repeat LFT in 3 months.
- PCOS: hirsutism, irregular menses. Status: ongoing. Plan: start metformin 500 mg BD, combined oral contraceptive pill OD, check testosterone and LH:FSH.
Due: HbA1c review 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg – take with breakfast, lunch and dinner (1-1-1).
Silymarin 140 mg – take morning, afternoon, night (1-1-1).
Rosuvastatin 5 mg – take once daily in the morning (1-0-0).
Metformin 500 mg – take twice daily, morning and night (1-0-1).
Combined oral contraceptive pill – take once daily (1-0-0).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting glucose 112 mg/dL (70-100).
HbA1c 6.4% (4.0-5.6).
Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), TG 165 mg/dL (<150).
Liver function: ALT 48 U/L (<40), AST 44 U/L (<40), ALP 88 U/L (40-129), GGT 32 U/L (<51), Bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).
Platelet count 225 x10^9/L (150-400).
Serum testosterone 48 ng/dL (15-46).
LH 8.2 mIU/mL, FSH 5.6 mIU/mL, LH:FSH ratio 1.46.
Waist circumference 102 cm.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Abdominal ultrasound: hepatic steatosis grade I, normal spleen, kidneys, no focal lesion.
Pelvic ultrasound: bilateral ovaries enlarged with multiple peripheral follicles, endometrial thickness 6 mm, no ovarian cyst >3 cm.
Impression: NAFLD grade I, PCOS with polycystic ovarian morphology.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity: weight 89 kg (down 2 kg), waist 99 cm. Status: improving. Plan: continue orlistat, reinforce portion control, add resistance training twice weekly.
- NAFLD: ALT 42 U/L, AST 38 U/L. Status: biochemical improvement. Plan: continue silymarin and rosuvastatin, repeat LFT in 3 months.
- PCOS: menses regular for past 2 cycles, less facial hair. Status: improving. Plan: continue metformin 500 mg BD and OC pill, consider testosterone recheck.
Due: HbA1c review 2025-10-10.

memories.text: I have been feeling more energetic and my periods are regular. No nausea from orlistat. I take my medicines as prescribed. I walk 30 minutes most days.
